column1: # The intended changes of plugin.spine43's Lua surface against a27bde4's, one row per changed key: + a key
# a27bde4 lacks, - a key it has. tests/api/suite.sh expects the line's surface to be a27bde4's with exactly these
# changes: an unlisted change fails its owner's test and so does a listed row the line does not show. An owner is
